Method of Attack: Ransomware payload copied to ADMIN$ share and executed via Windows Scheduled Task using Impacket
Ransomware payload copied to ADMIN$ share and executed via encoded PowerShell command using Impacket
Ransomware payload copied to Active Directory Domain Controller and deployed using Default Domain Group Policy Object
Encrypts files by adding .enc extension using CryptoPP C++ library AES encryption
Deletes backup catalog and all volume shadow copies to hinder recovery
Impacted Systems: Transportation and logistics organizations in Ukraine and Poland
Indicators of Compromise: README.txt ransom notes dropped in root directory of each encrypted drive
Attack Vector: Remote copying of ransomware payload to ADMIN$ share
Remote execution via Windows Scheduled Task
Remote execution via encoded PowerShell command
Deployment via Active Directory Group Policy
